questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Solutions. molality is defined as moles of solute per:
questions.explanation: Molality uses mass of solvent in kilograms.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Solutions. for an ideal solution, Raoult's law for component A is:
questions.explanation: Partial vapour pressure equals mole fraction times pure-component vapour pressure.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Electrochemistry. the SI unit of molar conductivity is:
questions.explanation: Molar conductivity is conductivity multiplied by volume per mole.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Electrochemistry. at the cathode of a galvanic cell, the process is:
questions.explanation: Reduction occurs at the cathode in every electrochemical cell.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Chemical Kinetics. for a first-order reaction, the unit of rate constant is:
questions.explanation: The first-order rate constant has dimensions of inverse time.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Chemical Kinetics. a catalyst increases reaction rate mainly by:
questions.explanation: A catalyst provides an alternative pathway with lower activation energy.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing d- and f-Block Elements. transition elements often show variable oxidation states because:

options.B: ns and (n−1)d electrons have comparable energies

questions.explanation: The energies of ns and (n−1)d orbitals are close.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Coordination Compounds. the coordination number of cobalt in [Co(NH3)6]Cl3 is:
questions.explanation: Six NH3 ligands are directly bonded to cobalt.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Haloalkanes and Haloarenes. the mechanism favoured by a tertiary alkyl halide in a polar protic solvent is often:
questions.explanation: Tertiary carbocations are relatively stabilised, favouring SN1 conditions.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers. phenol is more acidic than ethanol mainly because:
questions.explanation: The phenoxide conjugate base is stabilised by delocalisation.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids. tollens' reagent gives a silver mirror with most:
questions.explanation: Aldehydes reduce the diamminesilver(I) complex to metallic silver.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Amines. aniline is less basic than ammonia because:

options.B: lone pair is delocalised into the benzene ring

questions.explanation: Resonance delocalisation makes the nitrogen lone pair less available for protonation.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Biomolecules. the linkage joining two amino acids in a protein is:
questions.explanation: A peptide bond is an amide linkage between amino acids.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Biomolecules. the sugar present in DNA is:

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Coordination Compounds. the oxidation state of iron in [Fe(CN)6]4− is:
questions.explanation: Six CN− ligands contribute −6; overall charge −4, so Fe is +2.
